# 2 Baruch Chapter 78 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Baruch's Letters

---

**1** "Baruch son of Neriah speaks to his brothers and sisters in captivity. May mercy and peace be yours."

**2** "I think, my brothers, of the love of the One who made us — who has loved us from ancient times and never hated us, but above all has educated us."

**3** "I know for certain that all of us who exist in this present world will pass away — for the world itself will pass away."

**4** "The present age will not last forever, and the seasons of this earth will not go on endlessly."

**5** "Everything that exists now will vanish like a cloud, and disappear like a vapor."

**6** "The spirit and soul of every person will return to God who gave them."

**7** "When a person dies and comes before judgment, everything they did in this world will be displayed before the judgment seat, and all their thoughts will be examined."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Prioritizes clarity and natural English flow while preserving the theological and narrative content of the Syriac source.*
